newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks edge higher after opening a tad lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks edge higher after opening a tad lower.

text.p: Tokyo stock prices edged higher in early morning trade on Friday after opening a tad lower, extending gains accumulated over the past three days.
Brokers said the dissolution of parliament's Lower House, which will take place later on Friday, has already been factored in by the market.
After the first 15 minutes of trade, the cash market's benchmark 225-share Nikkei average was up 56.30 points or 0.26 percent at 21,517.67, after falling to 21,437.01.
In the futures market, the key December futures contract was up 30 yen at 21,580.
"Market participants may be reluctant to take up new positions before the weekend and momentum may be limited," said Yasuo Ueki, general manager at Nikko Securities.
